brief: THE BET, AND IT IS MEANT TO BE BIG — 150-300 lines are expected and welcome. The town has a road and nothing drives on it. `LN_ROAD0 68..76` is eight rows x 138 columns of laid setts with camber, gutters, ruts and kerbs, it crosses the whole width of every framing, and in 210 iterations the only object that has ever travelled it is the single `cart`/dray on market days. Both of spawnLaneAgent's walking lines (LANE_N_Y 66.4, LANE_S_Y 77.3) are on the FOOTWAYS. Give the carriageway continuous traffic: a stream of vehicles that enters at one end and leaves at the other, sized by the hour, the day and the weather the lane already knows. FABRIC, not an event — something is on the road in most frames, not a thing that happens at 11 o'clock. Price it before you build it: count what is on the roadway per sample over six seeds x a year on HEAD, so 'the road is empty' is a number and not my screenshot. Then size the population the way LAWS.md says — a ~40 s crossing at CART_SPEED-ish is a resident, so floor the arrival RATE and let trip length set how many are in frame. Re-use before you invent: `cart`'s heading ease, `cartShove()`'s berth and the walker-dodge it already implements are the precedent for anything on wheels, and the roadway is already in the ground cache, so a moving vehicle is a LIVE overlay and must not dirty it.
successLooksLike: In the wide shot at a busy hour something is moving along the carriageway in most frames, and the lane crop at 1600x950 shows traffic where it now shows one cyclist. On a wet day or after dark there is measurably less of it, off the weather scalars the lane already reads. Quote roadway occupancy per sample, HEAD vs candidate, over six seeds x a year, and the diff image's mass as a ratio to a same-code control.
avoid: Do not add another walker band — eastEdges already has six and the cyclist and the dog have fixed widths for a reason (see the comment above EAST_TAIL). Do not put anything on the roadway that stops there: this is TRANSIT, and a parked thing is roof furniture. Do not touch the market, the cafe or the kiosk. Do not widen or re-lay the road surface; it is right, it is simply unused. Anything drawn per frame must be a live overlay — do not set groundDirty from it.
